elements_selected.content: Write integration tests for the zetl blocks command covering all TEST-049 scenarios. Use assert_cmd + tempfile to create vault fixtures. Forward mode tests: list blocks for a file with heading/paragraph/table/spl leaf types; verify SPL leaves have spl_hashes; verify --type paragraph filter; verify page not found exits 1; verify hash from forward mode is usable as source metadata (roundtrip). Reverse mode tests: resolve known hash to correct file/lines/type; hash not found exits 1; ambiguous prefix exits 1 with candidates; duplicate content (create two identical paragraphs) exits 0 with both locations; prefix < 8 chars exits 1; full hash roundtrip (forward → resolve → same block). Use the demo-vault/decisions/Redis vs Memcached.md file as a fixture.
